title: Line Operated Three-Phase A.C. Motors (IE Code) — Specification
notifying_ministry: Ministry of Heavy Industries & Public Enterprises / DPIIT
scope: Specifies requirements and efficiency limits for three-phase line-operated squirrel cage induction motors from 0.12 kW up to 1000 kW operating on voltages up to 1000 V at 50 Hz.

supersedes.reason: Withdrawn and replaced by IS 12615 to mandate International Efficiency (IE) classes and harmonize with IEC 60034-30-1.
Superseded by Third Revision introducing mandatory IE3 baseline and refined testing methods.

clauses.title: Operating Conditions and Supply Voltage
clauses.text: Standard rated voltage shall be 415 V, 3-phase, 50 Hz. Motors shall be suitable for voltage variation of +/- 10% and frequency variation of +/- 5%.

clauses.title: Energy Efficiency Classes (IE Code)
clauses.text: All standard industrial single-speed motors within the scope of this standard shall conform to minimum Premium Efficiency Class IE3 when tested per IS 15999 (Part 2/Sec 1).

clauses.title: Insulation and Thermal Performance
clauses.text: Stator windings shall utilize Class F or Class H insulation system with temperature rise limited strictly to Class B limits (80 K by resistance method) under rated operating conditions.

normative_references.description: Mandatory standard for determining losses and efficiency from summation of losses tests.
Foot-mounted motor dimensions and frame size assignments.
Flameproof enclosure requirements for motors operating in hazardous gas atmospheres.
